vaultEnc.title: Vault encryption
vaultEnc.intro: Encrypts every note and file of this vault where it is stored, and the history, agent traces and search index Lumen keeps about them. Only the passphrase or the recovery key opens it.
vaultEnc.warning: An encrypted vault can't be read as plain text by Obsidian, git or any other program — only by Lumen with the passphrase. File and folder names stay visible.
vaultEnc.recoveryNote: Write it down or keep it in a password manager. It opens the vault if the passphrase is forgotten, even if the vault's encryption header is lost. Lumen shows it only now.
vaultEnc.recoverySaved: I have saved the recovery key
vaultEnc.retry: {n} files changed meanwhile: run Check and repair.
vaultEnc.broken: {n} files don't decrypt with this vault's key and were left as they are: {paths}
vaultEnc.repaired: {encrypted} encrypted, {plain} still plain text, {broken} not decryptable, {recovered} interrupted copies finished.
vaultEnc.turnOffNote: Decrypts every file back to plain text. Agent traces and the search index are deleted; history is kept.
vaultEnc.notDone: Not finished: run Check and repair.
vaultEnc.lockedNote: Enter the passphrase to open your notes.
vaultEnc.forgot: Forgot the passphrase? Use the recovery key
vaultEnc.recover: Open and set the new passphrase
vaultEnc.headerBroken: The vault's encryption header can't be read ({reason}). The recovery key opens the vault and writes a new one.
vaultEnc.kdfUpgradeNote: This vault's passphrase is protected with PBKDF2. Argon2id makes guessing it much slower. Update Lumen first on every device that opens this vault: an older Lumen can't open it after the switch. Only the header changes; no note is rewritten.
vaultEnc.kdfUpgraded: The passphrase is now protected with Argon2id.
